name: Navarro County, TX
findings: Navarro County has 143 nonprofit organizations. 49 of them (34%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 37 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (32% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, Navarro County has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.
43% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: Hobby and sports organizations stand out for public events
observations.text: 9 hobby and sports organizations here list public events, compared with about 1 in similar places of this size.
